title: Bündner Wirren
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bündner Wirren", at revision 1370607362, opens: "The Bündner Wirren was a conflict that lasted between 1618 and 1639 in what is now the Swiss canton of Graubünden." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q870205, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1618–1639 war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
